title: The Lantern Shelf
note: Captured from data/builder-designs/3WU3UN2.json with one change: bookends 4, where the saved design has 0. The /customize add-ons story hangs four: the right-hand end of each of the three shelves and the left-hand end of the top one. A design carries a count and nothing else about them, and /builder would fill the four lowest ends; the bake writes every end that can take one, and the story chooses from those.
